snippet.title: Beyond the Grove - Extended Gameplay Trailer (July 2025)
snippet.description:
Summon nature’s army in this charming RTS-inspired autobattler. Craft more than 50 unique magical golems by mastering the elements. Empower your armies to fight back against a mysterious corruption. Outsmart your enemies, discover synergies, and save your grove!
